health_condition_desc: Health condition start from Good (G). From the Okay (O) condition onwards, the Character immediately suffers a -1 penalty (-1 for Okay, -2 for Bad and -3 for Critical) until Agony.
skill_craft_desc: A measure of the Character's knowledge of traditional techniques and expertise in manual work. Also reflects a Character's ability to create, alter or repair manufactured objects.
skill_close_combat_desc: A measure of the Character's hand-to-hand combat techniques. Also reflects the Character's skill and technique in handling weapons.
skill_mounted_combat_desc: A measure of the Character's combat techniques astride a mount. Covers both traditional weapons and those designed for mounted combat. Also used for various horseback maneuvers.
skill_leadership_desc: A Character's ability to motivate and lead a group of individuals, to impose one's authority.
skill_communication_desc: A measure of the Character's rhetorical skills and techniques (public speech, oratory…), as well as social customs, and respect for Avalon's many codes and traditions.
skill_compassion_desc: A Character's ability to understand and feel another creature's (human or animal) emotions. Used to empathize with others, to grasp their feelings and comprehend their way of thinking or how they see the world.
skill_stealth_desc: A Character's ability to go unnoticed. Can be used to evade a foe's vigilance or to set up an ambush.
skill_erudition_desc: A measure of the Character's education and general knowledge. Used in many fields, such as knowledge of living things, history, the arts and literature. In Avalon, writing remains the prerogative of the elite; most individuals hire a scribe.
skill_inspiration_desc: A Character's ability to inspire their fellow human beings with courage and determination.
skill_magic_desc: A measure of the Character's knowledge on various arcane practices within the context and hardships of the island. Druids, wizards and mages can wield tremendous powers, but are often at risk because of it.
skill_natural_environment_desc: A Character's ability to move in the wilderness, through a hostile environment or one that hasn't been tamed by men. A Character proficient in this Domain has basic knowledge of agriculture, animals, camp life, etc.
skill_monsters_desc: A measure of the Character's knowledge of Avalon's abominations and their ability to identify what lurks in the mists. Also reveals a creature's weak points.
skill_wyrd_mysteries_desc: A Character's ability to understand the Wyrdness and its mysteries.
skill_perception_desc: A Character's ability to observe, pay attention to details and stay vigilant on a daily basis.
skill_feats_desc: A Character's ability to surpass themselves physically and perform exceptional physical deeds. Also reflects their strength, agility and dexterity.
skill_religion_desc: A measure of the Character's knowledge of Avalon's cults and religious practice.
skill_performance_desc: A Character's ability to create artistic works, to inspire, and to entertain.
skill_healing_desc: A Character's ability to heal a living being (human or animal), to clean scratches and dress fatal or infected wounds, as well as cure unknown afflictions or Wyrd-borne diseases.
skill_shooting_desc: A Character's ability to fight at a distance. Also reflects their dexterity in throwing a grappling hook or small projectiles.
skill_travel_desc: A measure of the Character's knowledge and techniques useful for travel and outdoor living.

way_awareness_desc: Measures a Character's link with their environment, the wild and the unpredictable world of Avalon.
way_combativeness_desc: Measures a Character's ardor and pugnacity, their motivation and will to act.
way_creativity_desc: Measures a Character's imagination, the way they confront a problem and how they see the world. It also tells of their inventiveness and resourcefulness.
way_conviction_desc: Measures a Character's fervor, commitment and beliefs.
way_reason_desc: Measures a Character's intellect, their ability for rationalization, the pliancy of their mind and perceptions. It also tells of their capacity to learn, their curiosity and natural propensity for matters of the mind.
detailled_attack: Attack ({{0}}) + Weapon's damage ({{1}}) - Target's defense ({{2}}) - Target's protection ({{3}})
speed_desc: Combativeness + Awareness. The speed is beneficial for the initiative roll.
defense_desc: Reason + Awareness + 5 (base). Opposes the opponent's attack to hit.
potential_desc: Value calculated based on your creativity. Allows you to more or less modify your attack/defense/speed depending on your Combat Attitude.
